Two new Ramsar sites added in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu

Posted On: 02 OCT 2026 11:00AM by PIB Delhi

India has added two wetlands to the list of Ramsar sites, taking the total number of Ramsar sites in the country to 93.

The new sites are Kolleru Lake in Eluru district of Andhra Pradesh and Kazhuveli Bird Sanctuary in Tamil Nadu.
